reason: A Git-based synchronization plugin for selectively comparing, reviewing, applying, recovering, and pushing DeepSeek Harness settings and profile configuration.

summaries.zh: 用于通过 Git 选择性同步 DeepSeek Harness 设置、配置文件、补丁和预设，并在审查后处理冲突、应用或推送更改。
summaries.en: A Git synchronization plugin for selectively comparing, reviewing, applying, recovering, and pushing DeepSeek Harness settings, profiles, patches, and presets.

capabilities: Connects to a configured Git remote
Reads selected DeepSeek Harness settings, profiles, patches, and presets
Compares local and remote configuration changes
Writes reviewed changes to local configuration files
Pushes selected local changes to the Git remote
Applies selected executable-related configuration changes after explicit confirmation
Creates backups and restores configuration files during recovery
